column1: # Kotlin test moves (PD111), read by scripts/android/kotlin_test_inventory.py --base REF.
# One rule per line: old_prefix<TAB>new_prefix. An id of the base ref that starts with
# old_prefix and is missing in the working tree is looked up again with old_prefix
# replaced by new_prefix; it passes when that id exists. Ids have the form
# so a rule moves one test, a class ("...:pkg.Class#") or a whole module set.
# A rule that matches no id of the base ref is stale and fails the check: delete it
# once the card that needed it is merged. Lines starting with # and blank lines are
# UX audit C5: an error toast stays until tapped, so the tests of its lifetime moved to the tap.
